description.en: Data-management-plan tooling for DeepSeek Harness: a ten-section scaffold with prompts and completeness/consistency checks (datasets, personal data, sharing, retention, backup, repository/license/DOI, contact), plus Markdown/JSON/SARIF export. Checks are internal consistency checks, not funder-template certification.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的数据管理计划（DMP）工具：十节脚手架与提示、完整性与一致性检查（数据集、个人数据、共享冲突、保存期限、备份、仓库/许可/DOI、联系人），输出 Markdown/JSON/SARIF。检查是内部一致性检查，不是资助方模板认证。
